title: Geometry-Dependent Approximation for Non-Monotone $k$-Submodular Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2610.04049v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the maximization of a nonnegative $k$-submodular function, not assumed monotone, in which each of $n$ elements receives one of $k\ge2$ labels or stays unselected and the selected elements must satisfy a constraint. For a compact convex down-closed region $P\subseteq[0,1]^n$ of fractional selection vectors, the diagonal level $\zeta(P)=\max\{t\in[0,1]:t(1,\ldots,1)\in P\}$ is the largest selection probability that can be given to all elements at once; it equals $r/n$ for a uniform matroid of rank $r$, and $\zeta(P)=1$ means that the constraint is vacuous. We give approximation coefficients that increase continuously with $\zeta$. They come from one inequality for the multilinear extension of the objective: the algorithm computes an action without querying the objective, and objective feedback gives a comparator-independent update direction. For $k\ge3$, feasibility of the action reduces to three polynomial inequalities

translated_title: 非单调 k-子模最大化的几何依赖近似算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究非负 k-子模函数（不假设单调性）的最大化问题，其中 n 个元素中的每一个被赋予 k≥2 个标签之一或保持未选中状态，且被选中的元素必须满足一个约束条件。对于由分数选择向量构成的紧致凸下封闭区域 P⊆[0,1]^n，对角水平 ζ(P)=max{t∈[0,1]: t(1,…,1)∈P} 表示可以同时赋予所有元素的最大选择概率；对于秩为 r 的一致拟阵，它等于 r/n，而 ζ(P)=1 意味着约束是空泛的。我们给出了随 ζ 连续增加的近似系数。这些系数源于目标函数多线性扩展的一个不等式：算法在无需查询目标函数的情况下计算一个动作，而目标函数的反馈则提供一个与比较器无关的更新方向。对于 k≥3 的情况，动作的可行性可归结为三个多项式不等式的判定。
tldr: 本文针对带约束的非单调 k-子模函数最大化问题，提出近似比随约束多面体几何特性（对角水平 ζ）连续提升的算法，其核心基于多线性扩展的一个不等式，无需查询目标函数即可计算动作，并利用反馈获得与比较器无关的更新方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algorithm for constrained non-monotone k-submodular maximization whose approximation guarantee continuously improves with the diagonal level ζ(P) of the constraint polytope, built on a single inequality for the multilinear extension that computes actions without querying the objective, using feedback as a comparator-independent update direction.
